title: PSG4-SEVENELEVEN-BANK: linear classical storage at the lower-source two-term profile

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ with n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE physical PSG4-SEVENELEVEN-BANK interpreter in proof.md, executing the complete scoped selected virtual program V in virtual.md, recovers the entire s with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8>2/3 from independent ideal coset copies. The selected actual threshold is u=max(1,floor(7R/11)), with C=4096, positive-width b+6 children, beta=21/20 and exact first-feasible profile; every parameter and both caps use that one configuration. Jointly on EVERY branch, including failures, discarded sources, wrong extracted labels, both resource aborts, padded bank initialization, source moves and output-first cleanup, total paid time T is O(2^((11/12)sqrt(n log2 n)+sqrt(n)(log2 n)^(-1/4))), with exact growth index 1/2. These are full exact supported envelopes with absolute outside constants independent of N,s and outcomes. Every basis-state, coherent, unused padded and source-moving wire and all allocator/controller metadata is counted. The CQ simulation preserves the whole output law and source-request sequence, while the positive G/2 internal time gap pays all polynomial interpretation and cleanup work. Current physical memory claims are not combined with virtual allocations. Correctness includes every finite input, and asymptotic envelopes have a positive finite-prefix extension. The four resources and clean fraction0 hold jointly.
